8.theme: THE 24 AUD-* CLAIMS - the audit corpus has already done most of the literature work

The rest cover the gate (AUD-GATE, AUD-RATELAW, AUD-KAPPA-TW, AUD-TIES, AUD-CYCLE-KERNEL), reproduction (AUD-REPRO13, AUD-REPRO-B2A95, AUD-MODULAR-ORACLE, AUD-VIMESTEP->AUD-TIMESTEP), scope/labelling (AUD-SCOPE-1.4, AUD-LABEL, AUD-HELDOUT-LABEL, AUD-RESP1-UNIFORM, AUD-CORR-0995-SCOPE), and 3 Incomplete open items (AUD-TIMESTEP, AUD-B-SCAFFOLD, AUD-NOVELTY-remainder).
Read the LIT-0041 and LIT-0042 abstracts to promote them from VERIFIED_METADATA to VERIFIED_FULL - both are load-bearing for the novelty claim.

Highest-value NEW question raised by round 7: is the AIEF capacity gate s_i = min(1, c/(q_i+eps)) multiplicative or subtractive in Miller-MacKay's (LIT-0043) sense? Neither, on inspection. That is a citable finding about the gate's form and it bears on AUD-GATE and AUD-RATELAW.
Do NOT adjudicate the 7 SSRH-ORIG-* claims without an owner decision - they are origin hypotheses, not repository results, and the primary sources are 31 MB of PDFs in Project Origins/.

known_gaps: All retrievals are metadata- or abstract-level except where noted VERIFIED_FULL. No paywalled full text was opened; no numbered theorem is attributed to a source that was not read.
No forward-citation or citation-graph analysis. The field map is search-driven and therefore recall-limited.
The repository cites no external literature anywhere in its working tree. This inbox is the project's first bibliography.

CORRECTION OF RECORD (round 4 F24): LIT-0030 (Earl & Strogatz) requires uniform in-degree k and does NOT apply to the adaptive AIEF network class. Its round-3 use was too strong. REJ-LOCK-03 support rests on LIT-0018 and LIT-0028; LIT-0030 is context only. The LIT-0030 snapshot was deliberately not rewritten (protocol); F24 is authoritative for its scope.

OPEN and OUTSIDE THE INBOX (round 3 F16, handed off in round 4 F22): 5 of 14 studies cite entrypoints that exist nowhere on disk or in any archive, including the entire AIEF 1.0-1.2 codebase registered as Frozen. verify_inventory.py does not check entrypoint referential integrity. This is registry/engineering work, not literature work, and needs owner approval.
EMP-AIEF14-03 and the three unmapped studies remain without a defensible external anchor. Not forced.
The inbox has reached lead-cleanness (7 leads opened, 7 resolved, 0 open). Further source addition would not change any claim's status.

Five citations - Seliger-Young-Tsimring 2002, Timms-English 2014, Picallo-Riecke 2011, Berner 2023, Miller-MacKay 1994 - none of which appeared in rounds 1-5. ROUND 6: LIT-0039 was physically in the repo all along as Papers/2804.05652v1.pdf, under an impossible arXiv ID (2804 cannot exist; correct ID 2304.05652). No Markdown references it, so a Markdown grep could never have found it.

Full history (198 commits, unshallowed) confirms zero commits ever touched any missing entrypoint filename and no AIEF_1_[012]_ path ever existed.

ROUND 7 OPEN QUESTION: the AIEF capacity gate s_i = min(1, c/(q_i+eps)) is a min-endpoint cap, which is arguably NEITHER multiplicative nor subtractive in Miller-MacKay's (LIT-0043) sense. AIEFS_salvage.md claims multiplicative normalisation produces the k*eta/c rates; that mapping is unverified.
